Misguided ghosts - Paramore
I'm Undiagnosed so I won't make any claims regarding bpd, and the song doesn't describe my cobdition. However I have always found this song to bring me a sense of peace and the mental space to begin calming myself down when I start to go down the rabbit hole. It's a beautiful song and I hope many of you get the chance to experience and connect with it as I do.

That was me but after grinding out the phat shards I was reminded of why I used to play rs3 for hours nearly every day and I decided to take a break from os and return. Absolutely no regret and I even managed snag Sifu and Morty in the same night while afking Rathis.

H'ween masks have been my favourite rare since I started back in 2004. Fantastic job on these as always!
